notes.title: 🏔️ Snow Resort Simulator – New Features & Improvements! 🎿
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Resort Managers,
[/h3]

We’re back with another exciting update for Snow Resort Simulator! Our development and artist team have been working hard to bring new features, visual improvements, and important bug fixes to enhance your resort management experience. 

[h3] 🆕 New Features:[/h3]

🎰 Slot Machines for Guests – Your visitors can now enjoy their time at the resort with brand-new slot machines! Let’s see who gets lucky!

👷 New Employee System & Worker Village – Feeling overwhelmed by all the tasks? You can now hire workers to assist with different jobs around the resort! To accommodate them, we’ve also added a dedicated worker village to the game.

🚠 Ski from the Summit – Take the cable car to the mountain peak and enjoy skiing all the way down!

❄️ Scenic Frozen Lake – A breathtaking frozen lake has been added to the map, offering an amazing winter view.

👥 New Customer Types – We’ve expanded our visitor variety with new character models to make the resort feel more dynamic and lively.

[h3] 🏨 Visual & Gameplay Enhancements:[/h3]

🏢 Updated Hotel Buildings – We've improved the hotel building models with enhanced visuals and more realistic details.

🛠️ Optimization – Various performance improvements to ensure smoother gameplay.

We’re continuously improving Snow Resort Simulator and can’t wait to hear your feedback. 

[b]Wishlist the game on Steam and stay tuned for more updates! [/b]

🏔️ See you on the slopes! 🎿
